versions.changelog:
- Initial release of SOP Document Writer (SOP流程文档生成器).
- Converts verbal or informal workflow descriptions into executable SOP documents with role division and exception handling.
- Engages users through interview-style questions to supplement missing key fields before generating documents.
- Ensures every SOP step includes clear responsible roles (RACI), exception handling, and deliverables.
- Output format: standardized Markdown document based on provided templates; adheres to operational best practices.
